potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user navigates the API documentation to understand available endpoints and their functionalities.

steps.element_description: Scroll through the API documentation sections to review details.
Click on 'Download OpenAPI specification' link to download the API reference.

expected_outcome: User obtains the OpenAPI specification document and understands the API endpoints.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user utilizes the 'Create Test App' functionality to define and generate test cases.

steps.element_description: Fill out the application configuration form with necessary details.
Submit the form to create a test application.

expected_outcome: Test application is successfully created with the specified configurations.
